escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, a dark studio at night, empty with only her own dark matte desk between her and the camera, no other furniture, no monitors, no plants, no lamps, nothing printed or analog anywhere, not even out of focus): an EFEONCE content strategist, a Latin American woman in her early thirties, dark curly hair tied up loosely, wearing the NAVY EFEONCE POLO exactly as in its reference, stands on the RIGHT side of the frame with her shoulders and chest turned about 30 degrees toward the sheet (frame right), so her near arm tucks in behind her torso and her silhouette is narrow, her head almost frontal, her face at about 70% of the frame width, her right elbow (frame left), hanging at her side, at about 58% of the frame width; between the left edge of the frame and that elbow there is a wide band of empty darkness; framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with a calm, rested, quietly confident expression and only the trace of a smile; her left hand rests in her trouser pocket and her right arm hangs relaxed at her side: she is not touching anything, the work happens on its own around her. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: the camera is about two meters away at chest height with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, so nothing is foreshortened and she does not lean toward the lens; her head occupies about one quarter of the frame height and her shoulders are clearly wider than two head-widths. In front of her on her left (frame right), about 25 cm in front of her face and slightly below her chin, BETWEEN her face and the camera, angled up toward her face, floats ONE published content piece made of light: a frameless sheet of pure light the size of a large hardcover book, thin as glass, with no bezel, no device and no screen, its face blazing white with only a few faint horizontal bars glowing slightly brighter, bars and not letters, too overexposed to read; no picture, no photograph, no landscape and no image block anywhere on it, white-hot at its core with a vivid azure-blue (#0375DB) glow along its edges. Tiny separate azure points of light, each one a visitor, come from far away and from many directions in the dark background on the right and CONVERGE on the sheet: the long-exposure trails start wide apart and faint in the distance and all narrow into its right edge, brightest where they touch it, like a funnel pointing at the sheet; nothing flows out of the sheet. Behind her, ALL of them to the RIGHT of her head, between 74% and 97% of the frame width, and six to eight meters away, hang more of the same white sheets of light, without any picture, at different depths, small and so far out of focus that they melt into soft round glows, each one with its own faint thread of arriving azure trails: the whole archive keeps pulling people in while nobody tends it. The near pane is the only light on her face: it paints the near side of her face (frame right), her neck and her near shoulder with white-azure light, while the far side of her face (frame left) falls into near-black shadow, as dark as the background; the exposure is set for the sheet’s light, so everything it does not reach drops to black; there is no light on her from the front: no fill, no reflector, no bounce. The embroidered mark on her chest keeps exactly the colour and relief of its reference, catching only a grazing edge of the light, never tinted azure or flattened; the polo stays a deep navy piqué with azure only on its highlights, never a royal-blue garment; nothing lights her from the camera side; a thin cool rim light from behind separates her hair and shoulders from the dark; thin haze catches the trails. Everything stays inside the RIGHT 55% of the frame: no sheet of light, no trail, no point and no light appears to the left of her right shoulder; between the left edge of the frame and her body there is a wide band of empty darkness. The LEFT 45% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze, no sheets of light, no trails, no objects. Rich contrast, deep navy blacks, one single accent colour (azure), no readable text, no screens, no logos of any other brand.
